name: jira_create_remote_issue_link
description:
Create a remote issue link (web link or Confluence link) for a Jira issue.

This tool allows you to add web links and Confluence links to Jira issues.
The links will appear in the issue's "Links" section and can be clicked to navigate to external resources.

icon_url.description: (Optional) URL to a 16x16 icon for the link

issue_key.description: The key of the issue to add the link to (e.g., 'PROJ-123', 'ACV2-642')

title.description: The title/name of the link (e.g., 'Documentation Page', 'Confluence Page')

url.description: The URL to link to (e.g., 'https://example.com/page' or Confluence page URL)
